name: geoparquet-lod
description: Read GeoParquet files with per-zoom display payload columns, and serve them as MapLibre vector tiles

scripts.test: node test/decode.test.mjs && node test/mvt.test.mjs && node test/pages.test.mjs && node test/http.test.mjs && node test/shared-load.test.mjs && node test/tile-pool.test.mjs && node test/visible-cache.test.mjs && node test/spill.test.mjs
scripts.demo: npm run demo:bundle && cd .. && npx -y http-server -p 8091 --cors -c-1 -o '/demo/?url=/buildings.lod.parquet' .
scripts.demo:bundle: esbuild src/index.ts src/maplibre.ts src/worker.ts --bundle --format=esm --outdir=../demo/dist && esbuild node_modules/@cogp/maplibre/dist/index.js node_modules/@cogp/maplibre/dist/worker.js --bundle --format=esm --outdir=../demo/dist/cogp && esbuild vendor/esri-sop/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=../demo/dist/esri.js
